messages:
Nora - Partnerships: Partner QA flagged flakiness when running our batch inference on A100 with driver 542 + CUDA 12.2. They hit sporadic OOMs and asked whether our marketplace image is safe for their POC next week.
Ivan - Eng Infra: Do we have a quick repro or a CI job? I'll run a narrow canary if we have steps.
Nora - Partnerships: Partner attached a short repro and logs in ticket P-998 (link: https://redwood-internal/partners/P-998). They used batch=12, seq=3072.
Lila - Runtime: I reproduced locally on lab A100. Pattern: memory climbs across requests and doesn't drop; 542 shows the issue, 538 looked stable. Suspect a driver allocation bug.
Sam - Marketplace: We were going to rotate stable -> 542 today. Given this, propose: put rotation on hold and create a pinned stable image at 538 for partner POC.
ReleaseBot: canary started: JOB-902 / a100-repro / https://ci.redwood/test/JOB-902
Ivan - Eng Infra: Action: I'll run extended canary on A100 (538 vs 542) and collect nv-crash + dmesg. If CI reproduces, we'll open vendor escalation.
Lila - Runtime: Runtime checklist for validation of vendor fix: 1) no memory growth across 1000 requests, 2) perf within 5% on critical traces, 3) successful run on multi-gpu NCCL jobs.
Nora - Partnerships: I'll update partner comms: "We paused the driver rotation and pinned a stable marketplace image while we validate a vendor fix. We can run your POC on the pinned image." Will share copy.
Sam - Marketplace: Hold applied: marketplace/stable pinned to driver 538. Added opt-in beta image for 542 with a warning. ETA for hold: 15m.
ReleaseBot: JOB-902 finished - A100 with 542 = FAIL (OOM growth), A100 with 538 = PASS. Logs: https://ci.redwood/test/JOB-902/logs
Ivan - Eng Infra: Confirmed. Opening vendor ticket BR-845 and attaching artifacts. Contacting driver team now.
Nora - Partnerships: Thanks team. We'll delay the public announcement until infra posts green. Partner PMs notified. :thumbsup:
